answer_1.quote: Inspired by successful applications of sequence-to-sequence (Seq2seq) models on other natural language generation tasks, several attempts have been made on leveraging Seq2seq model to automatically generate natural sentences as the answer to the given product-related question.
answer_1.outputs: natural language answer a = {t a 1 , t a 2 , ...} based on the question q and supporting documents D

answer_2.quote: Common automatic evaluation metrics include (i) ROUGE and BLEU for evaluating lexical similarity between generated answers and ground-truth answers, (ii) Embedding-based Similarity, BertScore, and BleuRT for evaluating semantic relevance, (iii) Distinct scores for evaluating the diversity of the generated answers.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation protocols are designed for evaluating different perspectives of the generated answer by human annotations, such as fluency, consistency, informativeness, helpfulness, etc.
answer_4.guideline: evaluating different perspectives of the generated answer by human annotations
